name: tracing-beam

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the top of the beam with its marker beside a complete first post; later frames are scrolled deeper.

tagline: A glowing gradient slides down a thin rail beside a scrolling article.
summary: A long-form reading column of photo posts wrapped by a thin left-hand rule. As the page scrolls, a cyan-to-violet glow and a small dot travel down the rule to mark progress.
appearance: A narrow dark reading column of stacked posts, each with a small solid badge, a bold white heading, a wide rounded mountain photo and a paragraph of grey text. Down the far left runs a fine vertical rule with a zig-zag kink near the top and a small dot marker.
behaviour: Scrolling sends a short cyan-to-violet gradient sliding down the left rule and drags a dot along with it, both eased through a stiff spring so they lag slightly. The top marker flips from green to white once scrolling begins.
demo_content: Four alpine posts headed Waking up above the clouds, Three days on the high path, and Coming back down.
search_phrases: line that follows you down an article
scroll progress beam beside blog posts
article with a glowing left rail
gradient line that moves with scrolling
vertical scroll indicator on a post
use_when: A long article or changelog wants a quiet progress cue running alongside the text.
avoid_when: You need an obvious progress bar at the top, or content has no left margin to spare.
customise: Articles go in as children and className pads the column. The zig-zag path, gradient stops and spring settings are fixed, while the beam height is measured from the content.
weight_why: One SVG path whose gradient and dot positions a scroll spring updates.

a11y.note: The beam hides itself under reduced-motion and the SVG is aria-hidden, but the demo's photos all use empty alt text.

issues: The beam sits well outside the text column and is faint enough to miss as progress.
In the frames it reads as a stray hairline rather than a deliberate indicator.
polish_why: Tidy editorial posts and a graceful scroll cue, but the beam is too quiet to carry the layout.
title: Tracing Beam
